reason: The picture links these signals to muscle genes becoming active, so pairing them with the unspecialized cells should start the muscle goal.
expectation: Some cells will develop toward making muscle proteins.

alternatives.reason: That looks like an equally plausible start for the supporting-cell goal.

effect: The signals produced young muscle cells whose muscle genes are active, but they do not yet have fibre bundles.
reaction: The picture makes the difference between activating genes and making fibres clearer.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, so they may help the young muscle cells make muscle proteins.
expectation: The cells will use the building blocks to make muscle proteins.

alternatives.reason: I could start the separate supporting-cell goal instead.

effect: The young muscle cells now contain growing muscle-protein bundles, completing the muscle goal.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the protein bundles appear after the genes were activated.
reason: The supporting-cell signals are pictured acting on another group of unspecialized cells, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: Some cells will begin developing into supporting cells.

effect: The signals created young supporting cells with support-protein genes active, but no surrounding fibre network yet.
reaction: This parallels the muscle cells before they made proteins.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, and they helped the young muscle cells make proteins.
expectation: The supporting cells will make protein fibres around themselves.

effect: The supporting cells made fibres around themselves, completing the remaining goal and showing a contrast with muscle cells keeping protein bundles inside.
reaction: The contrast made the two pathways clearer, though the second pathway felt somewhat repetitive.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making muscle proteins after activating muscle genes was worthwhile: the separate pictures showed that activating genes and producing protein bundles are different stages.

leastWorthwhile.text: Repeating the signal-then-building-block pattern for supporting cells was predictable after the muscle pathway, although the different result added a useful contrast.

surprise.text: The supporting cells released proteins to form material around themselves, while the muscle cells had bundles inside them.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The signals were named for their cell types, and the amino-acid pairing followed from their description as protein building blocks.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how these different cells contribute to organs, though I would hope for less repetition in the next chapter.
